item.title: PyPad 1.8.0 Released
item.description: - Important: PyPad 1.8.0 is now officially released. - Added a visible gamification shell with status widgets, momentum banner, and reward toasts. - Expanded the Productivity Hub with daily briefing, session review, milestones, secret trails, routines, and routine history. - Companion guidance now routes users into practical next actions like focus sprint, workspace sweep, and planning loop. - Gamification Dashboard now shows seasonal events, secret trails, and tracked productivity routine usage. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
